en.description:
## Xiaomi Redmi Note 14 Pro

A 6.67-inch curved AMOLED display at 120 Hz with a 200 MP main camera.

- 8 GB RAM, 256 GB storage
- 5000 mAh battery with 45 W fast charging
- IP68 water and dust resistance
- Dual SIM, NFC

One year warranty through our local service partner.
